title: Workday Forecasting Double Digit Revenue Growth
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc asks whether Workday is a buying opportunity after the company forecast double-digit revenue growth for fiscal 2028, and answers yes, but with explicitly low conviction. Revenue has grown nearly tenfold in a decade to $10.16 billion trailing, although the roughly 11% growth guided for fiscal 2028 is a marked slowdown from the prior decade's compounding. Profitability is improving alongside growth: non-GAAP operating margin is guided to 31% next quarter, a 200-basis-point improvement even while AI investment rises, cash flow from operations runs at about 30% of sales, and research and development has fallen from 44% to 27% of revenue, with further scale leverage expected. The AI business is real but still small relative to the legacy business — AI recurring revenue is $600 million trailing and customers have built more than 25,000 custom agents. Valuation carries the call: at a 14.1x forward P/E the stock is near its cheapest since late 2023, versus more than 40x historically, which he calls relatively cheap for double-digit growth with expanding margins. He is candid about the limits of the call: he has not yet run a discounted cash flow valuation and does not follow Workday frequently. Call made: WDAY BUY, low conviction, no price stated, first tracked Parkevtate WDAY call, no flip. Based on the captions analysis recorded in the 19:00 run on 2026-10-13.
